pages.title: Can Claude create invoices? Numbered, saved and tracked
pages.meta_description: Yes, as a document. The Invoice server also numbers each invoice, keeps it for later chats and records what each client has paid.
pages.answer: Yes, as a document. Claude can lay out an invoice from what you tell it, and with code execution on (the default on Free, Pro and Max) it can write it as a PDF or Word file. Projects and memory can keep your business details. What a chat does not keep is a number series that never repeats, or a record of what each client has paid. Connect the Invoice server (free token) and Claude creates invoices with the next number, saves them, records full or part payments and lists what is overdue.
native: Lays out an invoice from a list of items.
Writes it as a PDF or Word file when code execution is on.
needs: Invoice numbers that are never reused.
Full and part payments recorded against each invoice.
An overdue list across every client.

faq.q: Does it create invoices in QuickBooks or Xero?
faq.a: No. It keeps its own invoices and numbers under your token, and it writes nothing to QuickBooks or Xero.

faq.q: Do I get a PDF?
faq.a: On the hosted server invoice_pdf returns a one-hour link to an HTML invoice that you print to PDF from the browser. A local install writes the PDF file.

faq.q: What is free, and what does Pro add?
faq.a: Three invoices a calendar month, payments and the overdue report are free, and the free invoice page carries a small credit line. Pro is $19 once for the Invoice server, or $39 once for all 49 servers. It adds unlimited invoices, your logo with no credit line, and a custom number prefix.

pages.title: Can Claude find overdue invoices? Days late and totals
pages.meta_description: Partly. Claude can sort an invoice list you upload. The Invoice server keeps every invoice and lists the unpaid ones past due, worst first.
pages.answer: Partly. With code execution on (the default on Free, Pro and Max) Claude can read an invoice export you upload and sort out what is past due. A chat does not hold your invoices and payments, so its list is only as current as the file you gave it. Connect the Invoice server (free token) and Claude lists every invoice not paid in full whose due date has passed, worst first, with days overdue, the amount still open and a total per currency. Part payments you recorded are taken off.
native: Sorts an invoice export you upload by due date.
Drafts a reminder email for a late client.
needs: Every unpaid invoice past its due date, worst first.
Part payments taken off the amount still open.
A total per currency, never added across currencies.

example.note: Three invoices were created and USD 500.00 was paid on INV-2026-0001 first. The server answers in JSON. This is a shortened copy, and every field shown is unchanged. INV-2026-0002 also has a USD 150.00 credit note in the Billing Docs server, and this report shows the invoice before that credit.

example2.note: The server answers in JSON. This is a shortened copy, and every field shown is unchanged.

faq.q: Does it send reminders?
faq.a: No. It lists what is late. The Dunning Letters server writes reminder letters for each stage, and you send them.

faq.q: Does the report take off credit notes?
faq.a: No. It works from invoices and payments in the Invoice server. The Statement of Account server ages each client balance with credit notes taken off.

faq.q: What is free, and what does Pro add?
faq.a: The overdue report, payments and the invoice list are free on every tier, and creating invoices is free for 3 a month. Pro is $19 once for the Invoice server, or $39 once for all 49 servers. It adds unlimited invoices, your logo on the invoice page and a custom number prefix.

pages.h1: Can Claude make a credit note?
pages.title: Can Claude make a credit note? Against the original invoice
pages.meta_description: Yes, as a document. The Billing Docs server issues a numbered credit note against a saved invoice, line by line, and writes the text to send.
pages.answer: Yes, as a document. Claude can draft a credit note or credit memo from what you tell it, and with code execution on (the default on Free, Pro and Max) it can save it as a file. What a chat does not do is tie the note to the invoice it reverses, with its own number and the invoice's own prices. Connect the Billing Docs server (free token) and Claude credits a whole invoice, a gross amount or named lines of an invoice saved in the Invoice server, gives the note a CN number, and writes a plain-text version to paste into an email.
native: Drafts the wording of a credit note or credit memo.
Saves it as a file when code execution is on.
needs: A CN number and the invoice it reverses on every note.
Credited lines priced from the invoice's own lines.
A plain-text note ready to paste into an email.

Open, partly received or received status per order.
Each delivery kept with its date and note.

pages.h1: Can Claude write a payment reminder?
pages.title: Can Claude write a payment reminder? Letters that escalate
pages.meta_description: Yes, it writes them well. The Dunning Letters server also tracks which reminder each late invoice is on, adds agreed late fees and lists what to send today.
pages.answer: Yes. Claude writes a polite or firm payment reminder well, and Projects and memory can keep your usual wording. What a chat does not keep is which letter each late invoice has had, when the next one is due, or the interest your terms allow to date. Connect the Dunning Letters server (free token) and Claude registers each unpaid invoice, works out when reminder 1, reminder 2 and the final notice fall due, writes the letter for the current stage with any late fee, and lists what to send today. It sends nothing itself.
native: Writes a reminder in the tone you ask for.
Softens the wording for a client you want to keep.
needs: Three letters on a schedule counted from the due date.
Late payment interest at the rate your terms allow.
Today's list of letters to send.

pages.title: Can Claude track accounts receivable? Aging by client
pages.meta_description: Partly. Claude can age an export you upload. The Statement of Account server ages saved invoices by client, nets payments and credits, and writes statements.
pages.answer: Partly. With code execution on (the default on Free, Pro and Max) Claude can sort an invoice export you upload into 30, 60 and 90 day buckets in its sandbox. It works from that file each time, so payments and credit notes made since are missing. Connect the Statement of Account server (free token) and Claude ages the invoices saved in the Invoice server by client and currency, with payments, applied deposits and credit notes taken off, and writes a statement of account to email each client.
native: Ages an invoice export you upload in its sandbox.
Explains what an aging report shows.
needs: Aging per client from the invoices you already saved.
Payments and credit notes taken off each balance.
A statement of account to paste into an email.

pages.title: Can Claude read bank statements? Yes, and keep the history
pages.meta_description: Yes. Claude reads a PDF or CSV statement you upload. The Bank Statement server keeps imported months in a ledger you can total and search later.
pages.answer: Yes. Claude reads a bank statement you upload as a PDF or CSV and answers questions about it, and with code execution on (the default on Free, Pro and Max) it can total and chart the rows in its sandbox. Projects can keep the files. What a chat does not keep is one ledger that grows month by month with repeated rows skipped. Connect the Bank Statement server (free token) and Claude imports each CSV export into a saved ledger per account, totals money in and out by category, month or counterparty, and searches every stored line.
native: Reads an uploaded PDF or CSV statement and answers questions about it.
Totals and charts the rows in its sandbox when code execution is on.
needs: One saved ledger per account that later months add to.
Rows already imported skipped on the next import.
Totals by category, month or counterparty across months.

faq.q: Can it read a PDF statement?
faq.a: No. The server imports delimited text such as a CSV export. A PDF sent by link is refused, and one sent as bytes fails at import. Claude can still read the PDF itself in the chat.

faq.q: What is free, and what does Pro add?
faq.a: Two accounts, import, search and summaries are free, and the free tier reads back the last 12 months. Pro is $19 once for the Bank Statement server, or $39 once for all 49 servers. It adds unlimited accounts, the full history, unlimited category rules and the statement export.

faq.q: Where is my data kept?
faq.a: On the hosted server your records are kept for your token for 30 days, refreshed on every write. Install the server locally if you want nothing to leave your machine.

pages.title: Can Claude calculate depreciation? MACRS schedules by year
pages.meta_description: Yes, the math is simple. The Asset Register server keeps each asset and builds its schedule from bundled tax tables such as IRS MACRS, year by year.
pages.answer: Yes. Claude can explain straight-line and declining-balance depreciation and work out a schedule, and with code execution on (the default on Free, Pro and Max) it can build one in a spreadsheet. The risk is in the inputs, such as the wrong class life or convention, and a register that lives in one file. Connect the Asset Register server (free token) and Claude adds each fixed asset with its rate and life from a bundled table, IRS MACRS, HMRC pools or the Polish annex, builds the schedule per year or month, and values the register at any date.
native: Explains depreciation methods and works out a schedule.
Builds a schedule in a spreadsheet when code execution is on.
needs: Rate, life and convention from a bundled tax table.
A register of fixed assets kept between chats.
Net book value of the register at any date.

faq.q: Does it apply bonus depreciation or section 179?
faq.a: No. The US table is the GDS schedule under the half-year convention from IRS Publication 946 Table A-1. Ask your accountant whether bonus depreciation, section 179 or the mid-quarter convention applies to you.

Parts with markup and labour hours totaled from the lines.

faq.a: Not on the free tier. work_order_invoice_payload builds invoice-ready lines on Pro, and you raise the invoice in the Invoice server.

faq.q: What is free, and what does Pro add?
faq.a: Five open work orders, lines, status moves and the text completion report are free. Pro is $19 once for the Work Order server, or $39 once for all 49 servers. It adds unlimited open orders, the completion report PDF, the invoice payload and the board report.

pages.title: Can Claude track employee leave? Balances and who is out
pages.meta_description: Partly. Claude can add up days and build a tracker file. The Leave server keeps each request and approval, and shows balances and who is out on any day.
pages.answer: Partly. Claude can count days off from a list you paste, draft a leave policy and, with code execution on (the default on Free, Pro and Max), build a leave tracker spreadsheet. That file changes only when you ask for a new version, so requests, approvals and balances live in whichever copy you saved last. Connect the Leave server (free token) and Claude adds employees with their yearly allowance and carry-over, records vacation, sick, unpaid and parental requests, approves or rejects them, and shows balances and who is out in any date range.

faq.q: Does it skip weekends and holidays?
faq.a: No. It counts every day in the range you give, so book a week off as Monday to Friday.

faq.q: What is free, and what does Pro add?

pages.h1: Can Claude keep a mileage log?
pages.title: Can Claude keep a mileage log? Trips priced by date
pages.query: can claude keep a mileage log
pages.meta_description: Partly. Claude can total trips and build a log file. The Mileage Log server keeps every drive with its purpose and prices it at the rate in force that day.
pages.answer: Partly. Claude can total the miles in a list you paste and multiply by a rate, and with code execution on (the default on Free, Pro and Max) it can build a mileage log spreadsheet. That file grows only when you upload it again and ask for a new version. Connect the Mileage Log server (free token) and Claude logs each drive as business, medical, moving, charitable or personal, prices it at the rate you set for the day it was driven, and totals the deductible amount for any period. No rate ships with it, so you enter the one you use.
native: Totals the miles in a list you paste.
Builds a mileage log spreadsheet when code execution is on.
needs: A dated log of every drive with its purpose.
Each trip priced at the rate in force on its day.
Personal trips kept on record and left out of the total.

faq.q: Does it know the IRS rate?
faq.a: No. No rate ships with this server. You set the rate per category and the date it starts, and each trip is priced at the rate in force on its day.

faq.q: What is free, and what does Pro add?
faq.a: Twenty trips a calendar month, one rate per jurisdiction and category, the trip list and the summary are free. Pro is $19 once for the Mileage Log server, or $39 once for all 49 servers. It adds unlimited trips, a dated series of rates and the CSV export for your accountant.
